name: get_status
description: TV power state (on, standby, off) and the hub's connection state.

name: set_power
description: Turn the TV on (Wake-on-LAN) or off.

name: launch_app
description: Open an installed app by id (from list_apps).

name: play_youtube
description: Play a YouTube video in the TV's YouTube app by searching for it there (the TV ignores direct links). Pass a youtube.com/youtu.be URL, an 11-character video id, or the title / search words. Takes about 25 s.

name: search_youtube
description: Search YouTube (on the internet, not on the TV) and return the top videos: id, title, channel, length, live, views. Use it to turn a vague ask ('play some jazz', 'something chill') into one concrete video, then pass that video's id to play_youtube. For music or background asks, search for a long mix or live radio (e.g. 'jazz music mix', 'jazz radio live') and pick a result that is live or over an hour, from a popular channel.

name: run_macro
description: Run a saved key sequence by name (see the notes and list_macros). value replaces {value}.

name: list_macros
description: Saved key sequences with their steps.

name: save_macro
description: Create or replace a key sequence so it is remembered. Steps: {"key": "KEY_X", "repeat": n} | {"wait": seconds} | {"launch": app_id} | {"text": "...{value}...", "submit": bool}.

name: remember
description: Append a lasting fact about this TV or the owner's preferences to the notes (one short line).

name: skip_ad
description: Press OK once, which skips a YouTube ad when its Skip button is showing. Warning: if no ad is on screen this pauses the video. Only use when the owner asks.

name: open_twitch
description: Open a Twitch channel (streamer login name, e.g. 'ohnepixel'). Twitch on this TV ignores direct links, so this runs a blind search key sequence; the result can't be confirmed.

name: send_keys
description: Press remote keys in order. Valid keys: KEY_0, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_AMBIENT, KEY_CAPTION, KEY_CHDOWN, KEY_CHUP, KEY_CH_LIST, KEY_CYAN, KEY_DOWN, KEY_ENTER, KEY_EXIT, KEY_FF, KEY_GREEN, KEY_GUIDE, KEY_HDMI, KEY_HDMI1, KEY_HDMI2, KEY_HDMI3, KEY_HDMI4, KEY_HOME, KEY_INFO, KEY_LEFT, KEY_MENU, KEY_MUTE, KEY_PAUSE, KEY_PICTURE_SIZE, KEY_PLAY, KEY_POWER, KEY_PRECH, KEY_REC, KEY_RED, KEY_RETURN, KEY_REWIND, KEY_RIGHT, KEY_SOURCE, KEY_STOP, KEY_TOOLS, KEY_TV, KEY_UP, KEY_VOLDOWN, KEY_VOLUP, KEY_YELLOW. Use repeat for e.g. several volume steps.

name: type_text
description: Type into the TV's currently focused text field (a search box must be open). submit presses the keyboard's done/search.

name: wait
description: Pause, e.g. while an app loads (max 15 s).
